name: AiCoreChatDto — chat request contract

parityRequirement: the capability is reachable from chat in every channel that offers it today

parityRiskNote: Keeping this contract unchanged while declaring chat the primary interface caps the entire product's memory. There is no conversationId, threadId or sessionId field — confirmed by reading the whole DTO — so the CLIENT carries history, @ArrayMaxSize(12) caps it at twelve turns, and @MaxLength(2000) caps each. Consequences: conversation is lost on device switch or app reinstall, cannot be resumed on another surface (the same user moving from telegram to native starts blank), and cannot be audited as a conversation because nothing server-side ever held it. The DTO's own comment notes audience is 'only a presentation hint; authorization comes from server-side membership' — which is correct, and means a client cannot be trusted to restore its own history faithfully either.
rationale: A wire contract, not a surface — it is kept because it is the interface every chat-first client speaks. Verified fields exactly as inventoried: surface @IsIn(['native','web','telegram','voice']), optional audience @IsIn(['client','staff','owner']), requestId @Matches(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,128}$/), messages @ArrayMinSize(1) @ArrayMaxSize(12) of {role @IsIn(['assistant','user']), content @IsString @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(2000)}.

parityRiskNote: Its URL is an externally registered contract: https://malesthetic.pro/app/oauth-callback.html is the production redirect URI registered with the providers (CLAUDE_TASKS_FOR_CODEX.md:94). Moving, renaming or folding it into the app breaks social login for every user until each provider's console is updated — a change that cannot be rolled back from this repo. Its stylesheet href «/app/fonts.css» (L6) confirms it expects to live under /app/, unlike its siblings in the same directory, so a naive directory-level reorganisation will break it silently. rationale: Not a screen users navigate to — a transient authority-transition endpoint whose ordering guarantees are security properties. Governed by the security contract, invisible to the chat-first IA.
